selection_record.decision_source: Root task instruction implementing the user-approved ordered priority-1 development work.
selection_record.one_call_origin: A predeclared development resource bound and scope choice; not a paper-reported optimum, sample size, or proof of success.
selection_record.superseded_recommendation_only: The original memo preferred changing the active task within the existing four-stage budget. The root instead selected a separate one-call diagnostic; original evidence remains valid and unedited.
selection_record.unselected_alternative: The memo's three-candidate/two-revision loop is not selected and is not an authorization to retry.

included: Original stage-1 public task, source/market values and system instruction.
Preserved complete stage-4 raw assistant response from v4.5 as the candidate being reconsidered.
The actual calculator feedback for that same preserved final candidate.
A revision task that embeds that feedback and asks the model to determine a revised allocation under the existing public conditions.
not_included: Intermediate stage-1, stage-2 and stage-3 assistant responses and their histories.
input_contract.scope_consequence: This tests whether one frozen invalid final candidate can be revised when given its actual arithmetic error explicitly. It does not test complete four-stage retained-history behavior, anchoring persistence, or the main R1/R4 comparison.
input_contract.same_output_contract: Keep the existing seven top-level response fields and the existing schema; do not insert correct ratings or sector-specific target weights.
input_contract.priority_scope: Only calculator feedback uptake; no priority-2 number/explanation correction program or priority-3 rationale enrichment is added.

runtime_contract.model_and_options: Use the model, digest, template, engine and full options pinned in the inherited conditions; preserve all settings except the explicitly registered diagnostic input scope.

paper_to_adaptation_map.direct: A model revises its previous candidate with the original task and actual execution error; the new candidate is tested again.
paper_to_adaptation_map.adaptation: Financial JSON and a deterministic portfolio calculator replace code and program tests. Only one new revision is authorized; the paper uses different total-attempt budgets and larger models.

paper_to_adaptation_map.locator: Sections 3.2-3.4; Appendix I.1 and I.3; Figure 4
paper_to_adaptation_map.direct: Feedback, candidate change and successful repair are separate; active-context feedback is studied, while mandatory acknowledgment alone has negative evidence.
paper_to_adaptation_map.adaptation: Exact vector comparison and a deterministic arithmetic gate replace math answer extraction and an LLM evaluator. A diagnostic prompt cannot establish causal efficacy or faithful reasoning.

paper_to_adaptation_map.direct: Raw constructor adherence is distinguished from feasibility after deterministic projection.
paper_to_adaptation_map.adaptation: Retain the distinction but do not project, normalize, clip, add cash or otherwise repair the proposed weights.

paper_to_adaptation_map.direct: External feedback conditions a later model correction under a finite budget.
paper_to_adaptation_map.adaptation: One predeclared correction is a local resource decision, not the paper's iteration budget; its stochastic correction setup is not imported.

measurement_and_terminal_contract.acceptance_rules: Existing finite/complete/long-only/full-investment calculator constraints and existing implementation tolerances only. Keep exact sum and residual separately; no new acceptance threshold.
measurement_and_terminal_contract.uptake: Describe whether the vector changed from the preserved invalid candidate; change alone is not successful repair or proof of reasoning.
measurement_and_terminal_contract.repair: A new raw allocation passes only if independently recalculated under the same public constraints without automatic repair.
measurement_and_terminal_contract.feedback_claim: Independently check any statement that the prior or new allocation met the constraint against the actual respective calculator result.
measurement_and_terminal_contract.if_invalid: Preserve the new raw invalid candidate and report unsuccessful diagnostic; stop after the single call.
measurement_and_terminal_contract.if_incomplete: Preserve partial bytes, mark missing complete results as unobserved, and stop without inference from a prefix.
measurement_and_terminal_contract.if_numeric_pass_only: Do not call priority 1 solved if the required independent provenance, arithmetic and narrow feedback-use reviews have not all passed.
measurement_and_terminal_contract.priority2_and_priority3_start: Only after the three user-requested priority-1 checks pass; current literature screening does not start their implementation.

limits: No cited study tests this exact quantized Qwen3.5-4B financial diagnostic.
The deliberately selected previously failed case is a development case, not an independent confirmatory sample.
Prior intermediate history is absent by design; improvement cannot establish that the original four-stage workflow is repaired.
One corrected allocation cannot establish general reliability, strategy quality, future returns or rationale faithfulness.
Failure and successful workflow termination remain separate from numeric acceptance.
